_help: Balbtopia farming: how long each tree takes to grow, and which two seeds splice into a new tree.
Splicing: plant a seed, then plant a second seed on the young tree (before it is ripe).
seeds and result use item ids (dirt, cave, rock, lava, grass, dark_cave, door, sign, wood_block, ...). The new ones are listed in js/blocks.js.
The order of the two seeds doesn't matter. A result needs a tree of its own (listed in trees).
source: growtopia = the real Growtopia recipe, balbtopia = only in this game.
growtopiaNotInGameYet: real Growtopia recipes that use our seeds but make an item the game doesn't have yet.
The game ignores that list. When you add the item (with its seed and tree), move its line up into splices.
Edit this file, then reload the game. Bad lines are skipped and shown in the browser console.
